scope: Actual K3072/N1024 gate/up weights with natural M256/M512 routing replay. Both modes include producer BF16-to-D8 packing and emit the complete selected-down D4 activation cache.

candidate.geometry: Keep the production local128 P8 contraction. Launch gate alone to BF16 scratch, then launch up alone with a wave-local exact BF16 SiLU and direct D4 epilogue.
candidate.removed_work: The up BF16 global write, the subsequent gate/up global reread, and the standalone fused-SiLU D4 pack launch.
candidate.added_work: One additional selected-projection launch versus the combined gate/up contraction.

profiler.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-split-silu-prof.gA34su --output-file split-silu --log-level error -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-p8-precomputed-sums-production-silu-pack,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-p8-precomputed-sums-split-fused-silu-pack --warmups 0 --samples 1 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-split-silu-prof.gA34su/child.json
profiler.finding: The fused epilogue does not increase allocated resources, but splitting the same 16 output tiles across two launches loses more wall time than the removed 0.13-ms standalone pack repays.

decision: Reject and fully remove. The exact split formulation preserves local128 and avoids cross-wave exchange, but still regresses both natural primary shapes.
